2607.01034.title: Behavior-Adaptive Conversational Agents: Toward a Fluid Personality Framework
2607.01034.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-based conversational agents (CAs) are now ubiquitous, creating new opportunities for AI-mediated behavior change. Their capacity to project nuanced personalities and adopt diverse metaphorical roles raises a design question: how should an agent's persona and personality be calibrated to the moment? Recent evidence suggests that (i) moderate personality expression outperforms low or high extremes on trust, enjoyment, and intention to adopt in goal-oriented tasks, and (ii) context-appropriate metaphors outperform static one-note assistants on user experience and uptake. Yet most CAs still fix both persona and style, risking misalignment when dynamics, urgency, and formality vary, for example in medical information seeking, fitness coaching, and reflective learning. We propose a Fluid Personality Framework that jointly adapts (1) the agent's metaphorical persona, such as coach, tutor, librarian, or tool, and (2) its personality expression intensity, low, medium, or high, as a function of task context, user goals and traits, and situational urgency. We sketch the framework and its core design dimensions.
2607.01034.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的對話代理（CAs）現在無處不在，為 AI 介導的行為改變創造了新的機會。<lb/>它們展現出細緻的個性並採用多樣的隱喻角色，提出了一個設計問題：代理的角色和個性應如何根據當下進行調整？<lb/>最近的證據表明，(i) 適度的個性表達在信任、享受和採用意圖方面優於低或高的極端表達，並且 (ii) 上下文適當的隱喻在用戶體驗和接受度方面優於靜態的單一助手。<lb/>然而，大多數 CAs 仍然固定了角色和風格，當動態、緊迫性和正式性變化時，可能會導致不一致，例如在尋求醫療資訊、健身指導和反思學習中。<lb/>我們提出了一個流動個性框架，該框架共同調整 (1) 代理的隱喻角色，如教練、導師、圖書館員或工具，以及 (2) 其個性表達的強度，低、中或高，作為任務上下文、用戶目標和特徵以及情境緊迫性的函數。<lb/>我們勾勒出該框架及其核心設計維度。
2607.01034.author: Hasibur Rahman et.al.
